an8.62:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.62:1.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā.
an8.62:1.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.62:1.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:2.1: pañcahi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃparesaṃ.
an8.62:2.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu na heva kho khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu.
an8.62:2.8: sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.62:2.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, alaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:3.1: catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:3.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.62:3.7: no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā,
an8.62:3.8: no ca sandassako hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ.
an8.62:3.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano, nālaṃ paresaṃ.
an8.62:4.1: catuhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ, nālaṃ attano.
an8.62:4.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu,
an8.62:4.5: no ca dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhitā hoti,
an8.62:4.6: na ca atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti,
an8.62:4.7: kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo …pe… atthassa viññāpaniyā
an8.62:4.9: imehi kho bhikkhave, catuhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ nālaṃ attano.

an8.62:8.1: dvīhi bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ paresaṃ, nālaṃ attano.
